text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Shopping took longer than I thought! I'm barely going to make it to training!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Limited Time Lecture! Differentiating Fur Seals, True Seals, and Sea Lions"…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: H-how neat! I know training is starting soon, but…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I couldn't resist. I ended up staying until the end. I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Regardless of the subject of the lecture, she does seem to be genuinely sorry, so I let her off with a light warning.
